_comment_reg_valis: === Registration (VALIS) === valis-wsi 1.2.0 at its defaults: there are no VALIS registration settings.
_comment_seg_method: stardist is nextflow.config's default, with the trained model of segmentation_model: a Hugging Face snapshot pinned to one commit and downloaded on first use (into segmentation_model_dir when set; a copy already there is used offline). The StarDist knobs are seg_pmin, seg_pmax, seg_prob_thresh, seg_n_tiles_x and seg_n_tiles_y, and every one of them is silently discarded while seg_method is anything else. instantseg needs no trained model and its weights are Apache-2.0.
_comment_resources: === Resource Limits === NOT SET ON PURPOSE (R4). max_cpus/max_memory have no default and are required by nextflow_schema.json; they are per-SITE, not per-run, so they belong in your own -c site.config (copied from conf/site.config.template), never in a -params-file. A -params-file value overrides -c, so a resource block here would silently defeat any site.config you layer on top of this preset.
